picks.what: The central district from Mount Akhun, photograph
picks.why: only true general view: city spread along the Black Sea coast below the mountains

notes: #1 and #2 carry a camera-default date (1899-11-30) but are modern snapshots of a park and a street; not period views. #3 is Lazarevskoye, a distant resort district, seen from the sea; #4 is a night photo from space; #5 is a closer, less telling view of the Svetlana district.
